Protests Erupt After Youth Deaths, Clashes With Police Reported

Multiple incidents across India have seen protests and violence erupt following the deaths of young men. In some cases, the violence involved clashes with police, stone-pelting, and damage to vehicles. The underlying causes cited include alleged eve-teasing, road accidents, and disputes, with some reports indicating police negligence and subsequent suspensions.
